name: Germanic Spearman
notes: CR 1/2. Framea (thrown or melee) + seax backup. Pack Tactics. Wall assault -- ladders. Half speed on ladder, no Dash.
gm_notes: Session 2 raid, Phase 1-2, ladder climbers. Eight spearmen advance in two groups of four. Turn 1: throw framea at wall defenders before reaching the ladders (range 30/120). Turn 2-3: climbing (half speed, no Dash, no reaction while on ladder). Turn 3-4: reach parapet -- Pack Tactics immediately if another spearman is adjacent. Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls when an ally is within 5 ft of the target. Drops shield when climbing ladder (loses +1 AC until they grab it off their back -- DM discretion).
